title: PWK Entertainment
desc: A look at my former design and video-editing company.

about.title: About PWK Entertainment
text: PWK Entertainment was a company founded by PlaywithK, focused mainly on video editing and graphic design for social media channels.
The company handled both short-form and long-form video projects, as well as designs for Twitch, YouTube, and other social platforms.

history.title: History & Experience
text: PWK Entertainment was founded in September 2020 as an e-commerce business. Shortly after launch, the first interested clients appeared, and the project quickly gained momentum.
Although many aspects were new territory, from tax obligations and invoicing to individual customer support, a reliable workflow developed over time.

The main tools used were programs such as Filmora 12, DaVinci Resolve, Affinity Photo, and Affinity Designer. Designs and projects were always developed in close collaboration with clients and revised together when necessary until the final result was right. Despite the promising start, the company began to slow down after about a year. Orders became less frequent, and a larger planned deal fell through. As a result, things became financially challenging, and I ultimately decided to end PWK Entertainment for personal and economic reasons. The experience gained and creative growth during this time remain a valuable foundation for my future path.

reviews.title: Reviews
reviews.r1: I ordered a Twitch design including several panels, an offline screen, and a banner. The order was completed very quickly and exactly according to my wishes!
reviews.r2: A very serious and professional entrepreneur!
reviews.r3: The videos produced by PWK Entertainment are of very high quality and show that every project receives a special level of individuality and creativity.
